282430685.description: This listing includes two vintage Kaywoodie Drinkless tobacco pipes made from dark-stained briar wood with black stems. Both pipes feature classic curved designs and are marked with Drinkless Kaywoodie on the shank. One pipe stem shows visible wear and damage at the mouthpiece, while the other is in better condition but still shows signs of age. These collectible pipes have character and display age-related wear consistent with their vintage nature.

282042823.description: This lot includes two natural mineral specimens perfect for collectors. The first piece is a polished blue agate geode slice featuring a crystalline druzy center with banded blue, white, and dark quartz formations and a flat base for upright display. The second specimen is a raw matrix rock displaying a cluster of natural white and cream-colored crystal formations embedded in a gray stone base with natural jagged crystal points. Both specimens are in good display condition and showcase authentic geological formations ideal for mineral and gemstone enthusiasts.

Discover a delightful assortment with this Crystal Gem Collection featuring a unique assortment of tumbled and raw gemstones, complemented by handcrafted arrowheads. Housed in a sturdy clear plastic organizer, this set includes a variety of gemstones in assorted hues ranging from vibrant pinks, deep reds, soothing greens to classic clear and earthy tones, offering captivating visual interest and diversity. The set also features five arrowheads and one heart-shaped stone, providing a touch of historical and artisanal charm to the collection. Ideal for both collectors and those interested in geology or lapidary arts, this set lends itself to educational exploration, decor, or gift giving. Each stone and arrowhead is individually separated in the organizer, making it easy to view and access each piece. The stones appear to be in good condition, with minor visible wear on some surfaces.
